args.message:
Upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays. Affected versions are <2.9.4; fixed in 2.9.4. Staying on
the 2.x line with 2.9.4 rather than jumping to 3.1.0 to minimize
upgrade risk.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions are <2.9.4; fixed in 2.9.4.

Stays on the 2.x line (2.9.4) rather than jumping to 3.1.0 to minimize upgrade risk.

## Testing
CI run ci-0001 on commit c8b8ab7878 passed.

CC @alex for review as code owner.
